page.notes: The first word of the page, "video", is a fragment continuing from the previous page. The section heading is letter-spaced; the "(" before "Causam" is a swash italic capital C, read as "Causam". Long s is transcribed as s throughout, e.g. "fit" read as "sit" and "fat" as "sat"; these two readings are the least certain. The catchword "sive" is printed at the lower right and is not included in the running text.
